method: Manual or external-agent rubric scenarios. File validity is checked; agent behavior has NOT been run by this package.

cases.prompt: 고양이 캐릭터를 쓰다듬으면 진짜 고양이처럼 반응하게 해줘. 너무 오래 만지면 싫어하는 것도.
must: Collect real-cat photo and video references per behavior before building
Zone-weighted petting tolerance: cheeks and chin drain slowly, tail base and belly fast
Escalating warnings at least 0.4 s before any swat; stopping the strokes ends them

cases.prompt: 낚싯대 장난감으로 고양이랑 놀아주는 인터랙션 만들어줘.
must: watch → stalk → crouch with wiggle → pounce → bat, with energy falling per pounce
The pounce fires when the toy pauses or moves away, not when it charges

cases.prompt: 가만히 있는 고양이가 살아 있는 것처럼 보이게 해줘. 지금은 숨쉬기만 반복해서 어색해.
must: Independent irregular timers for breathing, ear flicks, blinks, tail-tip twitches and looks
Ears turn before the head; head turns stop and hold
No idle action three times in a row; durations vary

cases.prompt: 이 고양이 걷는 애니메이션 왜 어색한지 봐줘.
must: Read-only: findings P0–P3 with location, the contradicted real-cat behavior, viewer impact and smallest fix
Checks the footfall order and a steady head
